thread:
Mia: Quick FYI — opened a PR to add missing locales and clarify region availability + data residency notes for LATAM and MENA. Also updating the SDK example to include region header. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR opened by Mia: #4921 — size: small, labels: docs, region-coverage

Sam: Thanks! Can you paste the Python snippet you'll include? Want to confirm header name so we keep samples consistent.

Mia: Using header `X-Redwood-Region`. Short snippet I plan to include:
```python
client = Redwood(api_key="...")
# SDK convenience param
resp = client.generate("Summarize...", region="latam")
# explicit header example
client.set_header("X-Redwood-Region","latam")
```

Alex: Prefer showing the SDK param first (less error-prone), then the explicit header as an "advanced" example. Can we show both with a one-line note about server routing?

Jordan: Heads-up — linkchecker will fail if we link to the old external map or deprecated legal pages. Use /legal/data-residency (internal docs site) and add the footnote: "Regional availability and residency are subject to change; contact support for guaranteed SLAs."

Mia: Good catch @Jordan — I'll switch links to /legal/data-residency and add the footnote. I also added a tiny table: "LATAM — embeddings only (pilot), MENA — general availability Q2" (will verify status before merge).

Sam: Also add a migration note for customers: "If you used the older header `X-Region`, replace with `X-Redwood-Region` or use the SDK `region` param." Small code diff should be fine.

Mia: Done, pushed commit c3f4 (fix: migrate header name, update links, add footnote). Build triggered: https://ci.redwood.io/builds/2345

docs-bot: docs-bot: build 2345 started for PR #4921

docs-bot: docs-bot: build 2345 failed — linkcheck error in /docs/regions/overview.md: points to deprecated endpoint https://old.example.com/region-map

Mia: On it. Does anyone have the replacement map URL? I don't want to point to intranet-only links in public docs.

Jordan: The canonical map is internal only (https://intranet.redwood/region-map). For public docs, replace the link with "See the Regions page in the Console" and add a screenshot of the Console region selector. That avoids exposing internal URLs.

Alex: Screenshot + short instruction is fine. Add a note: "Console -> Settings -> Regions" so customers can find it. I can review after the fix.

Mia: Pushed fix: replaced external link with "See the Regions page in the Console (Console -> Settings -> Regions)" and added a screenshot under /assets/regions-console.png. Also updated the SDK snippet ordering per @Alex. Ready for review @Alex @Sam

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll review tomorrow morning and do a quick link-check locally.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR #4921 merge ready — reviewers approved

Mia: Merged. Tagged release notes: "docs: clarify regional availability and SDK region examples (LATAM, MENA); add migration note for region header."

Alex: Nice cleanup, thanks. We'll follow up if legal wants any wording changes for the residency footnote.

Mia: Noted — pinging Legal after lunch to confirm final phrasing.
